import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import pandas as pd
import io

data = """
amount,is_fraud,transaction_type,hour_of_day
115.02,0,refund,22
44.37,0,payment,5
144.25,0,transfer,21
536.22,0,payment,17
38.43,0,payment,5
"""

df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(data))

plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.barplot(x="hour_of_day", y="amount", hue="transaction_type", data=df)
plt.title('Amount by Hour of Day and Transaction Type')
plt.xlabel('Hour of Day')
plt.ylabel('Amount')
plt.legend(title='Transaction Type')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png')
plt.show()
